subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A restored historic house included a kitchen from one hundred years ago.”?
options: Students noticed there was no refrigerator, microwave, or electric stove.
Before it was removed, students noticed names and small drawings on its surface.
Students looked again and noticed large smiles, strong words, and promises without details.
Most students no longer noticed it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Students noticed there was no refrigerator, microwave, or electric stove.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Before it was removed, students noticed names and small drawings on its surface.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students looked again and noticed large smiles, strong words, and promises without details.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Most students no longer noticed it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students noticed there was no refrigerator, microwave, or electric stove.」，答案為「Students noticed there was no refrigerator, microwave, or electric stove.」。
